display.name: Twilio
display.blurb: Send SMS, place calls, and manage phone numbers via the Twilio REST API (2010-04-01). Authenticated with HTTP Basic (AccountSid:AuthToken), brokered at the egress proxy — the agent never sees the token.

cli.doc:
Use `twilio` to drive the Twilio REST API (2010-04-01) from this session — send SMS, place calls, and inspect phone numbers / recordings. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the real `Authorization: Basic <base64(AccountSid:AuthToken)>` header on every request to api.twilio.com. `TWILIO_BASIC_AUTH` is a managed placeholder — do NOT set a real token, paste credentials, or run any login.

Most resource paths embed your Account SID. The CLI reads it from `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` (a non-secret identifier, NOT auth) or you can pass it as the first segment; set it to your `AC...` SID if commands report a missing account. Subcommands:
  twilio whoami                          List accounts (Accounts.json) — verifies the brokered credential. Needs `account:read`.
  twilio sms <to> <from> <body...>       Send an SMS (POST Messages.json). Needs `messages:write`.
  twilio messages [Key=Value ...]        List messages, e.g. `twilio messages PageSize=20 To=+1555...`. Needs `messages:read`.
  twilio call <to> <from> <twiml-url>    Place a call (POST Calls.json, Url=<twiml-url>). Needs `calls:write`.
  twilio calls [Key=Value ...]           List calls. Needs `calls:read`.
  twilio numbers [Key=Value ...]         List your IncomingPhoneNumbers. Needs `phone_numbers:read`.
  twilio recordings [Key=Value ...]      List call recordings. Needs `recordings:read`.
  twilio get <path> [Key=Value ...]      Raw GET, e.g. `twilio get /2010-04-01/Accounts/AC.../Messages.json`.
  twilio api <METHOD> <path> [Key=Value] Raw call with any method (form-encodes Key=Value for POST/PUT).
The API returns JSON when the path ends in `.json` (the CLI appends it for resource subcommands); list responses are paged via PageSize / Page. A call to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.
